parent.title: [Roadmap] Unified AI router: cloud, CLI, ACP, semantic cache and scalable proxy fleet
parent.body:
## Outcome

Evolve llamactl into a horizontally scalable AI router with one model-based routing surface for **OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses and Anthropic Messages**, covering local, peer, cloud/API, CLI and ACP backends. Preserve local/peer compatibility, add exact → semantic → upstream caching, and separate stateless proxies from credential/process/session-owning execution workers.

This is a planning roadmap. No production implementation or runtime enablement is included.

## Design and evidence

[Full architecture, current-state traces, schemas, phased plan and evidence index](https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/blob/docs/unified-ai-router-roadmap/docs/specs/2026-09-23-unified-ai-router-architecture.md) Documentation review PR: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/pull/147.

Baseline: [`7443403912ab3976d18bc288de3009e2c23b7afb`](https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/commit/7443403912ab3976d18bc288de3009e2c23b7afb), verified as main on 2026-09-23.

Important corrections to the initial assumptions:
- `/v1/messages` already reaches model-based local/peer routing after its initial fallback is replaced by `resolveJsonBodyRoute`; native cloud/CLI/ACP support remains new work. See [routing](https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/blob/7443403912ab3976d18bc288de3009e2c23b7afb/packages/core/src/openaiProxy.ts#L1861-L1910).
- The current factory uses OpenAI-compatible providers, including Anthropic; `anthropic-direct` is not an existing native branch. See [factory](https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/blob/7443403912ab3976d18bc288de3009e2c23b7afb/packages/remote/src/providers/factory.ts#L23-L107).
- `via`/RAG is an existing alternate provider path, so the missing piece is ordinary model-catalog convergence. See [endpoint](https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/blob/7443403912ab3976d18bc288de3009e2c23b7afb/packages/remote/src/server/rag-chat-endpoint.ts#L438-L510).
- Tunnels already support subscriptions/cancel; they need execution semantics and queue bounds, not wholesale reinvention. See [bridge](https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/blob/7443403912ab3976d18bc288de3009e2c23b7afb/packages/remote/src/tunnel/router-bridge.ts#L94-L234).

## Architecture decisions

1. Core owns pure schemas, routing/cache policy and codecs. Remote owns HTTP/tRPC/provider/ACP transports. A new `packages/proxy` is a thin deployable composition root.
2. Keep native protocol payloads. Prefer Anthropic→Anthropic passthrough; translate only where capabilities permit. Preserve protocolVariant isolation in exact and semantic caches.
3. Cloud keys, CLI logins, ACP sessions and local KV state belong to execution workers by default. Proxy replicas hold only disposable catalogs, pools and in-flight state.
4. Semantic cache is opt-in pgvector/HNSW, exact-first, strict tenant/account/model/revision/system/protocol/embedder scope, original TTL, completion proof and calibrated profiles. Tools, side effects, reproducibility, CLI/ACP and unsupported profiles bypass approximate reuse.
5. Weighted rendezvous selects eligible execution replicas using request affinity. Exact shards use scoped request keys; semantic shards use compatible namespaces. Model-only or prompt-hash-only partitioning is insufficient.
6. Snapshots are observations and tunnels are transport. Managed owner/shard/session guarantees use transactional PostgreSQL leases, versions and fencing; durable storage replication is explicit.
7. No automatic retry after emitted output, uncertain acceptance or side-effecting execution. Stream/cancellation/usage contracts apply identically to all protocols.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  C["OpenAI and Anthropic clients"] --> P["Stateless proxy replicas"]
  P --> R["Authorized route and protocol selection"]
  R --> K["Exact and semantic cache services"]
  K --> D["PostgreSQL storage pools"]
  R --> E["Worker execution RPC"]
  E --> W["Local, cloud, CLI and ACP executors"]
  O["Catalog, leases and shard maps"] --> R
  O --> K
  O --> W
  W --> S["Peer observations and tunnels"]
  S --> O
```

## Delivery order and dependency policy

Default sequence: **0 → 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5 → 6**. Phase 3 can proceed after Phase 1 independently of CLI. The limited worker RPC required by CLI starts in Phase 2; Phase 4 versions/extracts it, avoiding a dependency cycle. Ephemeral ACP can ship before fleet-managed ACP sessions.

Child issues contain explicit **Depends on** links. Phase completion is the conjunction of its child acceptance gates, not merely merging the documentation. Every implementation slice remains independently gated and reversible.

### [Phase 3: Semantic cache](https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/milestone/4)

### [Phase 4: Independent proxy and cache services](https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/milestone/5)

### [Phase 5: Fleet coordination and sharding](https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/milestone/6)

### [Phase 6: ACP execution and sessions](https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/milestone/7)

- [ ] [[AI router P6.1] Add worker-owned ACP v1 ephemeral inference and protocol translation](https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/145)

## Cross-repository reference status

R0 is complete: Penumbra implementations and tests, actual Nova contracts and RaftIQ/geo-eval organization were reviewed at pinned commits in design §11. frozename/geo-eval redirects to RaftIQ/geo-eval. Key adaptations: acknowledged model selection, credential/tenant-scoped pools, truly incremental ACP delivery, bounded cancellation and no uncertain replay, canonical Nova usage/cancellation extensions. Agent-owned tools remain progress, never client-owned calls.

GitHub Projects v2 could not be inspected or created with the current token because Project scopes are absent. This roadmap uses phase milestones, labels, native subissues/dependencies and Markdown links. No board fields/views are claimed.

## Common implementation gates

- Use existing bun:test helpers, fake executable fixtures and random-port agent clusters; preserve current proxy/Responses/Anthropic/cache/KV/oMLX assertions.
- Keep core free of remote/tRPC/Electron imports; use Zod 4 and actual Nova contracts.
- Exercise all three protocol surfaces, JSON/SSE, error/abort, direct/tunnel, tenant/account isolation and revision invalidation.
- Run focused tests plus required typecheck/lint and four-repository compatibility gates from AGENTS.md. Missing sibling dependencies are a reported validation gap, never a pass.
- Flags default to legacy/off: unified/cloud/native-Anthropic/CLI, semantic off|shadow|serve, execution embedded|remote, fleet legacy|observe|rendezvous and ACP off|ephemeral|sessions.
- Record numerical latency/cost/false-hit and capacity criteria from measured baselines before rollout; no time estimates or invented performance guarantees.

## Decisions requiring implementation-time sign-off

Exact semantic-cache safety/thresholds per task; tenant identity and authorization model; immutable cloud-model generation policy; accepted Anthropic ancillary surface; selected/pinned ACP agents and sandbox profiles; provider credential egress policy; PostgreSQL HA and restore responsibilities; rolling-upgrade support window.

The full design explains recommended defaults, migration concerns and risks. This tracker is an issue-based roadmap; a native GitHub Projects board is not assumed.

## Penumbra fleet execution

Every child includes an execution contract and a manifest entry with an explicit file fence, ordered dependency gates, focused bun:test commands, required full gates, independent review and expected artifacts. The 18 implementation entries include schema-validated task.file payloads. R0 is completed and excluded from dispatch. Runtime project/seat binding and dependency enforcement belong to the registrar; tasks were prepared, not executed. [Fleet manifest](https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/blob/docs/unified-ai-router-roadmap/docs/specs/2026-09-23-unified-ai-router-publication.json).

## Registrar and tracking ledger

[Repository ledger](https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/blob/docs/unified-ai-router-roadmap/docs/unified-ai-router-registrar.md) tracks all 19 stable work-package IDs, dependencies, acceptance gates, evidence, execution ownership and rollout status. The [publication manifest](https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/blob/docs/unified-ai-router-roadmap/docs/specs/2026-09-23-unified-ai-router-publication.json) contains its machine-readable tracking snapshot and append-only history. Penumbra registrar **llamactl-unified-ai-router** (`2c2a7cbb-048c-45e5-8663-f15187b9e85b`) is registered as draft, with R0 complete, P0-P6 pending, 18 owed implementation follow-ups and one unresolved baseline acceptance blocker. Registration does not dispatch work. Reconcile GitHub facts before transitions and close follow-ups/blockers using their original event IDs.

issues.title: [AI router R0] Complete pinned Penumbra, Nova and geo-eval reference review
issues.body:
## Roadmap and dependencies

Parent: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/127
Phase: Reference review
Depends on: none.
Design: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/blob/docs/unified-ai-router-roadmap/docs/specs/2026-09-23-unified-ai-router-architecture.md#11-completed-reference-review-and-publication-organization
Documentation PR: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/pull/147

## Problem and scope

The initial draft required actual Penumbra ACP/CLI implementations, Nova contracts and the intended geo-eval roadmap to be reviewed before finalizing integration decisions. This research is complete. Implementation and real-agent qualification remain in the dependent issues.

## Completed findings

- Penumbra pinned at c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62; read AGENTS.md and inspected adapters, discovery/carriers, lifecycle/pool, permissions/workspace, observability and corresponding tests. Full reuse/adapt/reject matrix is in design §11.1.
- Nova contracts 0.1.0 pinned at 71fe71dbf72fe99f4e53e68b5be9b3d420c446ad; cancellation and unknown-usage gaps now have concrete P0.2 schema/migration and P1.3 acceptance work.
- frozename/geo-eval redirects to RaftIQ/geo-eval; template pin 5909170b640ac09eaee6c9a164f1711d324bd519. Applied work-package/class/readiness labels, phase milestones, file/Check/Done-when structure and dependency links. Native parent/dependencies are added for this roadmap. Project fields/views are inaccessible because token scopes lack read:project/project; no board is claimed.
- Sirius and Embersynth selected source blobs were matched to public pins 1ae980bd59951e9e23fdc738d05a3032e199d4c2 and bd51abdb1b5f08f8293789c4444804b7b50656e6; preserve their adapters and coordinate Nova changes.
- Current official ACP v1 reviewed: strict newline transport, negotiated versions/config selectors, cancellation/prompt result, capability-gated load, and agent-owned tools.

## Concrete targets and contracts

Documentation: docs/specs/2026-09-23-unified-ai-router-architecture.md and its publication manifest. Implementation follow-through: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/130, https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/133, https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/134, https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/135, https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/145, https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/146. Shared schemas stay in Nova; private Penumbra modules do not become a core dependency.

## Evidence and test review

- **Adapter boundary (Adapt)**: [packages/agentchat/src/sdk/adapter.ts:1–71](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/src/sdk/adapter.ts#L1-L71). Tests inspected: [packages/agentchat/test/sdk/adapter-types.test.ts:1–20](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/test/sdk/adapter-types.test.ts#L1-L20). DispatchInput carries signal, permissions and execution context, but DispatchOutput is text/metadata and tool-event variants are reserved. Use a remote BackendExecutor wrapper with Nova payload types; do not import Penumbra worker/core into llamactl core.

- **Provider discovery and argv (Adapt)**: [packages/cli/src/commands/generator/discovery-acp-session.ts:87–174](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/cli/src/commands/generator/discovery-acp-session.ts#L87-L174); [packages/config/src/generator/carriers.ts:35–109](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/config/src/generator/carriers.ts#L35-L109). Tests inspected: [packages/cli/test/commands/generator/discovery-acp-session.test.ts:133–306](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/cli/test/commands/generator/discovery-acp-session.test.ts#L133-L306); [packages/config/test/generator/carriers.test.ts:1–104](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/config/test/generator/carriers.test.ts#L1-L104). The probe initializes and creates a session without prompting, extracts availableModels, and distinguishes skipped discovery. Token-level carriers keep argv boundaries. Catalog evidence is not selector enforcement or editing conformance; require worker-owned bounded discovery and an acknowledged model selector.

- **CLI subprocess lifecycle (Adapt)**: [packages/agentchat/src/adapters/cli-spawn.ts:126–197](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/src/adapters/cli-spawn.ts#L126-L197); [packages/agentchat/src/adapters/cli-spawn.ts:249–345](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/src/adapters/cli-spawn.ts#L249-L345); [packages/agentchat/src/adapters/codex-cli.ts:7–68](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/src/adapters/codex-cli.ts#L7-L68). Tests inspected: [packages/agentchat/test/adapters/cli-spawn.test.ts:155–270](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/test/adapters/cli-spawn.test.ts#L155-L270); [packages/agentchat/test/adapters/cli-spawn.test.ts:428–469](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/test/adapters/cli-spawn.test.ts#L428-L469). Shell-free spawning, process groups, signal escalation, streaming decoders and output caps are implemented. Generic Codex arguments come from configuration, not request.model. Keep Bun runtime and test real fake executables; bind requested model to approved argv, destroy readers on deadline and test surviving descendants.

- **ACP wire framing (Adapt)**: [packages/agentchat/src/adapters/stdio-acp-client.ts:44–173](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/src/adapters/stdio-acp-client.ts#L44-L173); [packages/agentchat/src/adapters/stdio-acp-client.ts:180–280](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/src/adapters/stdio-acp-client.ts#L180-L280). Tests inspected: [packages/agentchat/test/adapters/stdio-acp-client.test.ts:184–300](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/test/adapters/stdio-acp-client.test.ts#L184-L300). Custom JSON-RPC client, newline default plus content-length compatibility. Content-length has caps, but the newline reader and pending request map do not establish bounded backpressure. Use strict newline ACP v1 by default, explicit agent profiles for custom framing, byte/request/queue caps and writer drain handling.

- **Initialize/auth/model negotiation (Adapt; reject implicit model guarantees)**: [packages/agentchat/src/adapters/stdio-acp.ts:1390–1415](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/src/adapters/stdio-acp.ts#L1390-L1415); [packages/agentchat/src/adapters/stdio-acp.ts:1474–1522](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/src/adapters/stdio-acp.ts#L1474-L1522). Tests inspected: [packages/agentchat/test/adapters/stdio-acp.test.ts:1441–1581](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/test/adapters/stdio-acp.test.ts#L1441-L1581); [packages/agentchat/test/adapters/stdio-acp-model-warmup.test.ts:1–100](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/test/adapters/stdio-acp-model-warmup.test.ts#L1-L100). ProtocolVersion 1 is sent; authentication is retried once after auth-required. session/new.model and warmup prompts are agent-specific selection conventions. Returned protocol/capability/model acknowledgement must be validated by the new adapter. Advertising auth methods alone does not authorize interactive login.

- **Process pool and reload (Adapt)**: [packages/agentchat/src/adapters/acp-warm-pool.ts:100–175](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/src/adapters/acp-warm-pool.ts#L100-L175); [packages/agentchat/src/worker/warm-pool-reload.ts:1–37](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/src/worker/warm-pool-reload.ts#L1-L37). Tests inspected: [packages/agentchat/test/adapters/stdio-acp-integration-warm-reuse.test.ts:75–159](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/test/adapters/stdio-acp-integration-warm-reuse.test.ts#L75-L159); [packages/agentchat/test/adapters/stdio-acp-integration-cold-fallback.test.ts:29–94](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/test/adapters/stdio-acp-integration-cold-fallback.test.ts#L29-L94). Implemented pool acquires idle live processes and checks spec identity; actual subprocess tests assert one process with fresh session/new per dispatch. Extend scope to tenant, account, credential generation, sandbox/workspace policy and binary/config revision. A fresh session does not erase process credentials. Start ephemeral execution with pooling disabled; enable only per vetted profile.

- **Streaming and usage (Adapt event interpretation; reject drop-in streaming)**: [packages/agentchat/src/adapters/stdio-acp.ts:1150–1202](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/src/adapters/stdio-acp.ts#L1150-L1202); [packages/agentchat/src/adapters/stdio-acp.ts:1786–1839](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/src/adapters/stdio-acp.ts#L1786-L1839); [packages/agentchat/src/adapters/stdio-acp.ts:1867–1889](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/src/adapters/stdio-acp.ts#L1867-L1889). Tests inspected: [packages/agentchat/test/adapters/stdio-acp.test.ts:867–938](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/test/adapters/stdio-acp.test.ts#L867-L938); [packages/agentchat/test/adapters/stdio-acp.test.ts:1293–1360](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/test/adapters/stdio-acp.test.ts#L1293-L1360). The stdio generator awaits prompt completion and emits done after accumulating text; capture callbacks are not an incremental public iterator. Implement bounded notification-to-iterator delivery and source-result validation. Session usage/context occupancy is not per-request input/output billing; keep unknown provenance.

- **Abort, timeout and retry (Adapt cleanup; reject transparent replay)**: [packages/agentchat/src/adapters/stdio-acp-server.ts:37–133](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/src/adapters/stdio-acp-server.ts#L37-L133); [packages/agentchat/src/adapters/stdio-acp.ts:1578–1619](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/src/adapters/stdio-acp.ts#L1578-L1619); [packages/agentchat/src/adapters/stdio-acp.ts:1695–1715](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/src/adapters/stdio-acp.ts#L1695-L1715); [packages/agentchat/src/adapters/stdio-acp.ts:1957–1975](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/src/adapters/stdio-acp.ts#L1957-L1975). Tests inspected: [packages/agentchat/test/adapters/stdio-acp-server.test.ts:1–131](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/test/adapters/stdio-acp-server.test.ts#L1-L131); [packages/agentchat/test/adapters/stdio-acp.test.ts:1361–1440](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/test/adapters/stdio-acp.test.ts#L1361-L1440). Processes receive TERM/KILL and pool eviction; idle-wire timers differ from total HTTP deadlines. The cold-retry predicate is transport/pool based, not a proof of non-acceptance. Add ACP session/cancel then bounded drain, pending permission cancellation, absolute deadline and reader teardown; do not replay an uncertain or side-effecting turn.

- **Session load/resume/history (Reject as an existing reusable implementation)**: [packages/agentchat/src/adapters/stdio-acp.ts:1786–1828](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/src/adapters/stdio-acp.ts#L1786-L1828); [packages/agentchat/src/adapters/stdio-acp.ts:1935–1953](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/src/adapters/stdio-acp.ts#L1935-L1953). Tests inspected: [packages/agentchat/test/adapters/stdio-acp-integration-warm-reuse.test.ts:130–156](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/test/adapters/stdio-acp-integration-warm-reuse.test.ts#L130-L156). Inspected stdio dispatch always creates a new session; the handoff injector sends another prompt but is not a fenced turn sequencer. No managed load/resume/history contract is established by this path. P6.2 must implement capability-gated loading, replay suppression, expected-turn CAS and unknown-outcome handling.

- **Permissions/tool ownership (Adapt bounded ledger; reject trust-all profile)**: [packages/agentchat/src/adapters/stdio-acp-permission.ts:1–51](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/src/adapters/stdio-acp-permission.ts#L1-L51); [packages/agentchat/src/adapters/stdio-acp-permission.ts:106–130](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/src/adapters/stdio-acp-permission.ts#L106-L130); [packages/agentchat/src/adapters/stdio-acp-permission.ts:187–280](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/src/adapters/stdio-acp-permission.ts#L187-L280). Tests inspected: [packages/agentchat/test/adapters/stdio-acp-permission.test.ts:196–285](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/test/adapters/stdio-acp-permission.test.ts#L196-L285); [packages/agentchat/test/adapters/stdio-acp-permission.test.ts:376–454](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/test/adapters/stdio-acp-permission.test.ts#L376-L454); [packages/agentchat/test/adapters/stdio-acp-permission.test.ts:635–724](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/test/adapters/stdio-acp-permission.test.ts#L635-L724). Session/tool identity, one-shot decisions, retired IDs and fail-closed bounds are implemented and tested. Do not import bypass selection into public inference. Agent tool updates stay internal progress; filesystem/terminal callbacks service the agent once, never also emit a client-owned function call.

- **Workspace and credential isolation (Adapt; add OS enforcement)**: [packages/agentchat/src/adapters/acp-fs.ts:78–104](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/src/adapters/acp-fs.ts#L78-L104); [packages/agentchat/src/adapters/stdio-acp.ts:1717–1745](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/src/adapters/stdio-acp.ts#L1717-L1745). Canonical path restrictions and provider-specific environment scrubbing are useful patterns, not a complete multi-tenant sandbox. Public callers cannot choose paths, commands or auth. Use worker credential references and allowlisted child environments; enforce OS/container workspace and network policy. Bound reads before allocation, not only returned text.

- **Reliability/observability (Adapt evidence taxonomy)**: [packages/core/src/services/dispatch-reliability.ts:11–117](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/core/src/services/dispatch-reliability.ts#L11-L117). Classifies missing lifecycle evidence and unknown worktree/terminal facts separately. Reuse the approach with request/attempt/owner/sequence IDs, queue/admission/wire-terminal events and scrubbed metadata; do not import handoff database or task status as inference completion proof.

- **OpenCode adapter name (Reject as proof of portable stdio ACP)**: [packages/agentchat/src/adapters/opencode-acp.ts:623–757](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/src/adapters/opencode-acp.ts#L623-L757). This adapter consumes OpenCode HTTP/SSE semantics and has its own usage limitations. Its name does not prove standard ACP stdio or current draft HTTP conformance. Treat it as a separately versioned remote adapter if selected.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Pinned implementations and tests inspected, matrix recorded in design.
- [x] Official ACP semantics reconciled, including model selection and tool ownership.
- [x] Nova request/stream/error/usage gaps assigned to actual upstream contracts and consumers.
- [x] Useful geo-eval organization applied; Project capability gap explicit.
- [x] CLI/ACP issues carry actionable adaptations and test gates.

## Compatibility, rollout and rollback

Research/documentation only; no flags enabled, dependencies installed, runtime code copied, services restarted or deployment performed. MIT licensing was inspected; any later substantial code copy must retain its notice. Source links into private repositories require access; the public summary excludes source excerpts and operational material. Closing R0 records completion of research, not completion of the dependent implementations.

## Penumbra fleet execution contract

Status: completed research. Retain this contract for audit; do not file or dispatch an implementation task.

Before dispatch, resolve the registered Penumbra project by verified git origin frozename/llamactl, fetch main, read AGENTS.md, and record cwd, clean status, exact base SHA and dependency implementation SHAs. The reviewed baseline is 7443403912ab3976d18bc288de3009e2c23b7afb; use current main containing accepted dependencies, not a stale forced reset. Do not touch an operator checkout. Use an isolated worktree, one task/branch and one writer per overlapping file fence. Dependency issue closure alone is insufficient: verify its accepted PR is merged or its explicit completed-research evidence. Never dispatch a blocked child, and do not enqueue all children and assume the task queue enforces GitHub dependencies.

Implement only this issue. Treat the Concrete targets, test paths and explicit sibling targets below as the file fence. Read referenced modules freely; expand the write fence only with a recorded scope change before edits. Preserve unrelated changes. No merge, deployment, live credentials, live model runs or feature activation. Keep rollout flags at their documented defaults. Prepare a focused PR after required gates; report blockers without expanding into unrelated baseline repairs.

Use a producer-consumer assertion that fails for the intended missing behavior (RED), minimal implementation (GREEN), a deliberate relevant mutation that makes it fail, restoration, and fresh focused/full gates. Missing dependencies, fixture services or a failing mandatory gate are blockers, not PASS. Return: VERDICT: PASS or FAIL; issue URL; base/final SHAs; changed-file fence proof; test and mutation evidence; compatibility/migration/flag/rollback evidence; independent review result and unresolved findings; actual PR URL. Expected artifacts are commit, PR and review_verdict. Do not declare success from exit code alone or from empty/skipped suites. No time estimates.

### Focused checks and write fence

Re-fetch the design, PR, roadmap, 19 children and native relationships; validate pinned references and no unresolved publication placeholders.

Machine-readable write fences, dependency gates, focused commands and the fully resolved `task.file` payload are in [the publication manifest](https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/blob/docs/unified-ai-router-roadmap/docs/specs/2026-09-23-unified-ai-router-publication.json), selected by this issue ID. If @nova changes, run `bun install` in every consumer first. The documentation-time llamactl baseline was not fully green; reproduce and classify failures rather than inheriting a false PASS. Disposable PostgreSQL/pgvector and real fake executables are required where this issue names them; absent services do not count as passing integration tests.

### API binding (verified, not inferred)

The registrar submits only `fleet.task_file` after binding its verified local `project_id` and authenticated creator identity, then links the returned task ID to this existing GitHub issue using `task.link_gh`. Do not set `gh_create` or create duplicate issues. Deduplicate by existing task-to-GitHub association before filing. `task_class`, `task_type`, the branch and dependency policy are registrar/chain metadata, not fields accepted by the strict task.file API. The registrar must apply them to the selected chain/worktree and lane before leasing. At the reviewed implementation, task.file stores branch_base only for orchestrate tasks, so a work-task payload cannot enforce its branch. Resolve registered seats at dispatch, preserve configured model/cost policy and require an independent reviewer; no invented seat or premium fallback is supplied. This publication prepares tasks; it does not file or execute fleet work.

issues.title: [AI router P0.1] Characterize existing local, peer, Anthropic, Responses and cache behavior
issues.body:
## Roadmap and dependencies

Parent: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/127
Phase: 0 — Baseline
Depends on: None.
Design: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/blob/docs/unified-ai-router-roadmap/docs/specs/2026-09-23-unified-ai-router-architecture.md

## Problem

Preserve the actual proxy behavior before introducing providers. The supplied local-only Anthropic assumption is incorrect: resolveJsonBodyRoute overrides its initial fallback for a routable model. Separate that supported path from actual defects, including dropped Anthropic stream and full-buffer cacheable SSE misses.

## Scope

1. Pin baseline 7443403912ab3976d18bc288de3009e2c23b7afb and record expected compatibility behavior and known defects.
2. Add peer-only Anthropic/Responses fixtures, local alias/collision precedence, unknown-model legacy fallback, request-model/path assertions, via/RAG JSON behavior, deterministic cache and protocolVariant isolation.
3. Make the fake upstream stream only when it receives stream:true, so translation cannot accidentally pass an unconditional SSE fixture.
4. Characterize abort, truncated/error SSE, response-cache completion, peer revision invalidation and existing llama.cpp/oMLX KV behavior. Fix defects in their implementation slices rather than marking incorrect behavior as desired.

## Concrete file/module targets

All paths below are repository-root relative. New paths are proposals, not claims about existing files.

- `packages/core/test/openaiProxy.test.ts`
- `packages/core/test/openaiProxy.responses.test.ts`
- `packages/core/test/openaiProxy.abort.test.ts`
- `packages/core/test/responsecache/proxy-integration.test.ts`
- `packages/remote/test/proxy-characterization.test.ts` (new)
- `AGENTS.md` (correct stale tunnel/secret resolver descriptions)

## Contracts and schemas

No persisted schema change. Freeze representative public JSON/SSE/error envelopes as compatibility fixtures.

## Test strategy

Use bun:test, makeTempRuntime/envForTemp, makeCluster and random-port Bun servers. Assert what upstream actually receives. Record existing-bug reproductions separately; keep unchanged behavior assertions green. No live cloud calls.

Use bun:test with makeTempRuntime/envForTemp, makeCluster, random-port fixture servers and real fake executables; do not mock Bun.spawn. Run focused tests and required typecheck/lint plus the AGENTS.md four-repository gate (llamactl, nova, sirius-gateway, embersynth) for implementation slices. Report unavailable sibling checkouts as gaps. No production inference/credentials in hermetic CI.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Local and peer requests are covered for all existing supported ingress shapes.
- [ ] Conditional Anthropic streaming fixture exposes lost stream:true; peer epoch and protocol isolation assertions exist.
- [ ] Baseline errors, fallback and abort expectations are documented; current KV/oMLX test coverage is retained.

## Migration, rollout and rollback

Tests/documentation only, no runtime flag or migration; this becomes the regression gate for every later phase.

## Verified baseline references

Baseline: frozename/llamactl@7443403912ab3976d18bc288de3009e2c23b7afb. The implementation acceptance tests listed above are planned, not claimed as implemented or passing. Reference inspection is complete in R0.

issues.body:
## Roadmap and dependencies

Parent: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/127
Phase: 0 — Baseline
Depends on: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/129.
Design: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/blob/docs/unified-ai-router-roadmap/docs/specs/2026-09-23-unified-ai-router-architecture.md

## Problem

Routing currently mixes HTTP transport, local workload fields and winner-only peer routes in core. A minimal shared seam is needed before adding cloud/CLI without violating core→remote dependency direction.

## Scope

1. Define a protocol-neutral envelope retaining immutable native payload, normalized supported features, authenticated scope, deadline, request/attempt IDs and cache policy.
2. Define route advertisements with publicModelId, upstreamModelId, deploymentId, backendKind, ownerWorkerId, transport location, capabilities, account namespace, model/config revisions and health/capacity observations. A peer is a location, not a backend kind.
3. Retain all deployment candidates; define deterministic alias collision rules and explicit equivalent-replica groups. Do not collapse distinct providers with the same short model name.
4. Introduce remote createProxy composition and a legacy local executor; validate wrappers against the pinned @nova/contracts version before implementation.

## Concrete file/module targets

All paths below are repository-root relative. New paths are proposals, not claims about existing files.

- `packages/core/src/inference/contracts.ts` (new)
- `packages/core/src/routing/catalog.ts` (new)
- `packages/core/src/routing/capabilities.ts` (new)
- `packages/remote/src/proxy/create-proxy.ts` (new)
- `packages/remote/src/inference/legacy-local-executor.ts` (new)
- `packages/core/src/index.ts`
- `packages/remote/src/index.ts`

## Contracts and schemas

InferenceEnvelopeV1, RouteAdvertisementV1 and explicit feature capabilities per design §4.1–4.3. Core contains pure Zod 4 schemas/policy; provider SDK and tRPC types stay remote. No incomplete fleet wire format is persisted.

## Test strategy

Add packages/core/test/routing/catalog.test.ts and packages/remote/test/proxy-composition.test.ts. Test candidate retention, alias collisions, capability rejection, embedded old/new fixture equivalence and absence of core imports from remote/tRPC/Electron.

Use bun:test with makeTempRuntime/envForTemp, makeCluster, random-port fixture servers and real fake executables; do not mock Bun.spawn. Run focused tests and required typecheck/lint plus the AGENTS.md four-repository gate (llamactl, nova, sirius-gateway, embersynth) for implementation slices. Report unavailable sibling checkouts as gaps. No production inference/credentials in hermetic CI.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Legacy local/peer behavior passes P0.1 under the new composition seam.
- [ ] Capability filtering happens before credentials or execution are acquired.
- [ ] Shadow catalog construction performs no billable inference and does not expose secret values.

## Migration, rollout and rollback

LLAMACTL_UNIFIED_PROXY=0|1 defaults off. No kubeconfig rewrite; preserve legacy behavior. Shared @nova changes, if needed, must be versioned in Nova and installed in consumers.

## Verified baseline references

## Problem

Routing currently mixes HTTP transport, local workload fields and winner-only peer routes in core. A minimal shared seam is needed before adding cloud/CLI without violating core→remote dependency direction.

## Scope

1. Define a protocol-neutral envelope retaining immutable native payload, normalized supported features, authenticated scope, deadline, request/attempt IDs and cache policy.
2. Define route advertisements with publicModelId, upstreamModelId, deploymentId, backendKind, ownerWorkerId, transport location, capabilities, account namespace, model/config revisions and health/capacity observations. A peer is a location, not a backend kind.
3. Retain all deployment candidates; define deterministic alias collision rules and explicit equivalent-replica groups. Do not collapse distinct providers with the same short model name.
4. Introduce remote createProxy composition and a legacy local executor; validate wrappers against the pinned @nova/contracts version before implementation.

## Concrete file/module targets

All paths below are repository-root relative. New paths are proposals, not claims about existing files.

- `packages/core/src/inference/contracts.ts` (new)
- `packages/core/src/routing/catalog.ts` (new)
- `packages/core/src/routing/capabilities.ts` (new)
- `packages/remote/src/proxy/create-proxy.ts` (new)
- `packages/remote/src/inference/legacy-local-executor.ts` (new)
- `packages/core/src/index.ts`
- `packages/remote/src/index.ts`

## Contracts and schemas

InferenceEnvelopeV1, RouteAdvertisementV1 and explicit feature capabilities per design §4.1–4.3. Core contains pure Zod 4 schemas/policy; provider SDK and tRPC types stay remote. No incomplete fleet wire format is persisted.

## Test strategy

Add packages/core/test/routing/catalog.test.ts and packages/remote/test/proxy-composition.test.ts. Test candidate retention, alias collisions, capability rejection, embedded old/new fixture equivalence and absence of core imports from remote/tRPC/Electron.

Use bun:test with makeTempRuntime/envForTemp, makeCluster, random-port fixture servers and real fake executables; do not mock Bun.spawn. Run focused tests and required typecheck/lint plus the AGENTS.md four-repository gate (llamactl, nova, sirius-gateway, embersynth) for implementation slices. Report unavailable sibling checkouts as gaps. No production inference/credentials in hermetic CI.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Legacy local/peer behavior passes P0.1 under the new composition seam.
- [ ] Capability filtering happens before credentials or execution are acquired.
- [ ] Shadow catalog construction performs no billable inference and does not expose secret values.

LLAMACTL_UNIFIED_PROXY=0|1 defaults off. No kubeconfig rewrite; preserve legacy behavior. Shared @nova changes, if needed, must be versioned in Nova and installed in consumers.

## Roadmap and dependencies

Parent: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/127
Phase: 1 — Cloud and protocols
Depends on: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/131.
Design: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/blob/docs/unified-ai-router-roadmap/docs/specs/2026-09-23-unified-ai-router-architecture.md

## Problem

Messages, Chat Completions and Responses need one route-selection pipeline, with lossless native Anthropic handling. At baseline factory.ts always creates OpenAI-compatible providers; a native Anthropic adapter is new work, not an existing anthropic-direct branch.

## Scope

1. Resolve the ingress model before translation, retain native payload, then choose a backend protocol strategy from capabilities. Route all three surfaces through the same catalog/executor/cache seam.
2. Implement native Anthropic Messages JSON/SSE forwarding with model rewrite and allowlisted semantic headers; preserve thinking/signatures, content blocks, cache-control and beta/version semantics. Never round-trip native Messages through OpenAI.
3. Fix Anthropic stream:true and object-form tool choice; implement supported Responses streaming with proper event sequencing. Reject lossy unsupported features instead of dropping them.
4. Add capability-routed /v1/messages/count_tokens and authorized model discovery. Define Messages compatibility explicitly; Files, Batches and server-tool parity are separate scope, not silently claimed.
5. Accept Anthropic SDK auth form according to llamactl identity policy; never forward public x-api-key or Authorization as provider credentials.

## Concrete file/module targets

All paths below are repository-root relative. New paths are proposals, not claims about existing files.

- `packages/remote/src/providers/anthropic-native.ts` (new)

- `packages/core/src/anthropic/types.ts`

- `packages/core/src/responses/translateRequest.ts`

- `packages/remote/src/server/serve.ts`
- `packages/remote/src/server/auth.ts`

## Contracts and schemas

Ingress protocol discriminant, native semantic-header fingerprint, native/translated capability matrix and protocolVariant scope. Do not share cache entries across Anthropic/OpenAI/Responses.

## Test strategy

Add packages/remote/test/proxy-anthropic-native.test.ts and proxy-protocol-matrix.test.ts; extend core Anthropic/Responses suites. Test native payload/header preservation, thinking signatures, conditional streaming, tools over three turns, peer routing, content-type/size errors, translated feature rejection and credential separation with actual SDK clients against fixtures.

Use bun:test with makeTempRuntime/envForTemp, makeCluster, random-port fixture servers and real fake executables; do not mock Bun.spawn. Report unavailable sibling checkouts as gaps. No production inference/credentials in hermetic CI.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The same model selects the same deployment policy for all three ingress protocols.
- [ ] Native Anthropic request/response semantics survive without lossy conversion; translated paths advertise a tested subset.
- [ ] Messages stream reaches upstream as stream:true; count_tokens does not fabricate unsupported results.

## Migration, rollout and rollback

LLAMACTL_PROXY_ANTHROPIC_NATIVE and LLAMACTL_PROXY_RESPONSES_STREAM default off. Native Anthropic conversion uses an operator-reviewed config diff; existing OpenAI compatibility nodes are not silently migrated.

[AI router P1.2] Converge three protocol surfaces and add native Anthropic passthrough

## Roadmap and dependencies

Parent: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/127
Phase: 1 — Cloud and protocols
Depends on: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/131.

## Problem

Messages, Chat Completions and Responses need one route-selection pipeline, with lossless native Anthropic handling. At baseline factory.ts always creates OpenAI-compatible providers; a native Anthropic adapter is new work, not an existing anthropic-direct branch.

## Scope

1. Resolve the ingress model before translation, retain native payload, then choose a backend protocol strategy from capabilities. Route all three surfaces through the same catalog/executor/cache seam.
2. Implement native Anthropic Messages JSON/SSE forwarding with model rewrite and allowlisted semantic headers; preserve thinking/signatures, content blocks, cache-control and beta/version semantics. Never round-trip native Messages through OpenAI.

4. Add capability-routed /v1/messages/count_tokens and authorized model discovery. Define Messages compatibility explicitly; Files, Batches and server-tool parity are separate scope, not silently claimed.

issues.title: [AI router P1.3] Unify streaming, scoped exact caching and usage across proxy and tRPC
issues.body:
## Roadmap and dependencies

Parent: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/127
Phase: 1 — Cloud and protocols
Depends on: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/132.
Design: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/blob/docs/unified-ai-router-roadmap/docs/specs/2026-09-23-unified-ai-router-architecture.md

## Problem

Cacheable SSE misses currently buffer upstream.arrayBuffer before replay, while tRPC has separate streaming behavior and billing paths. New adapters must preserve incremental output, distinguish source completion from fabricated terminal events, and avoid duplicate charges.

## Scope

1. Define shared ordered execution events and one terminal outcome. Translate partial text/tool JSON incrementally, preserve IDs/indexes, handle fragmented UTF-8 and propagate cancellation through every adapter.
2. Replace full-body buffering with bounded in-line capture. Stop capture (not delivery) at the limit; publish only proven complete success. Bound parser queues; avoid an unbounded tee or producer queue.
3. Introduce scoped exact-cache identity for new adapters including authenticated tenant/account, model/config revision, generation policy and protocolVariant. Preserve existing canonical V1 semantics and local KV behavior; decouple response caching from KV eligibility.
4. Centralize execution usage ownership and dedupe by request/attempt; distinguish delivered cache hits, upstream-reported usage, estimates and unknown cost. Adapt chatComplete/chatStream and via/RAG to the shared service, preserving RAG augmentation and avoiding recursive public proxy calls.
5. For a provider without streamResponse call createResponse and synthesize content+terminal output, rather than emitting only done.

## Concrete file/module targets

All paths below are repository-root relative. New paths are proposals, not claims about existing files.

- `packages/core/src/inference/events.ts` (new)
- `packages/core/src/inference/cache-contracts.ts` (new)
- `packages/remote/src/proxy/stream-capture.ts` (new)
- `packages/remote/src/inference/usage.ts` (new)
- `packages/remote/src/router.ts`
- `packages/remote/src/server/rag-chat-endpoint.ts`
- `packages/core/src/openaiProxy.ts`
- `packages/core/src/responsecache/registry.ts`

## Contracts and schemas

ExecutionEventV1 completion evidence, CacheScopeV2 for new adapters, usage provenance/attempt dedupe and delivery ledger. Cache key version migration must not reinterpret existing SQLite entries.

## Test strategy

Add packages/remote/test/proxy-streaming.test.ts; extend chat-usage.test.ts, chat-stream-usage.test.ts, rag-chat-endpoint.test.ts and core responsecache/proxy-integration.test.ts. Use a blocked-completion fixture proving first chunk arrives before completion, slow consumers, oversized captures, partial/error streams, abort and one billing record. Test non-stream-only AiProvider synthetic streaming.

Use bun:test with makeTempRuntime/envForTemp, makeCluster, random-port fixture servers and real fake executables; do not mock Bun.spawn. Run focused tests and required typecheck/lint plus the AGENTS.md four-repository gate (llamactl, nova, sirius-gateway, embersynth) for implementation slices. Report unavailable sibling checkouts as gaps. No production inference/credentials in hermetic CI.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Streaming misses remain incremental and memory bounded; incomplete/aborted/error responses never enter exact cache.
- [ ] One upstream execution yields one usage charge across tRPC/proxy paths; cache delivery is distinct.
- [ ] Tenant/account/protocol/revision mismatches cannot hit cache; peer/oMLX/KV regressions pass.

## Migration, rollout and rollback

Enable scoped cloud exact caching only after completion and identity gates. Existing local exact cache remains usable. Keep legacy tRPC path until parity passes, then converge internally without a core→remote shim.

## Verified baseline references

Baseline: frozename/llamactl@7443403912ab3976d18bc288de3009e2c23b7afb. The implementation acceptance tests listed above are planned, not claimed as implemented or passing. Reference inspection is complete in R0.

## Roadmap and dependencies

Parent: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/127
Phase: 1 — Cloud and protocols
Depends on: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/132.

## Problem

Cacheable SSE misses currently buffer upstream.arrayBuffer before replay, while tRPC has separate streaming behavior and billing paths. New adapters must preserve incremental output, distinguish source completion from fabricated terminal events, and avoid duplicate charges.

## Scope

1. Define shared ordered execution events and one terminal outcome. Translate partial text/tool JSON incrementally, preserve IDs/indexes, handle fragmented UTF-8 and propagate cancellation through every adapter.
2. Replace full-body buffering with bounded in-line capture. Stop capture (not delivery) at the limit; publish only proven complete success. Bound parser queues; avoid an unbounded tee or producer queue.
3. Introduce scoped exact-cache identity for new adapters including authenticated tenant/account, model/config revision, generation policy and protocolVariant. Preserve existing canonical V1 semantics and local KV behavior; decouple response caching from KV eligibility.
4. Centralize execution usage ownership and dedupe by request/attempt; distinguish delivered cache hits, upstream-reported usage, estimates and unknown cost. Adapt chatComplete/chatStream and via/RAG to the shared service, preserving RAG augmentation and avoiding recursive public proxy calls.
5. For a provider without streamResponse call createResponse and synthesize content+terminal output, rather than emitting only done.

All paths below are repository-root relative. New paths are proposals, not claims about existing files.

- `packages/core/src/responsecache/registry.ts`

ExecutionEventV1 completion evidence, CacheScopeV2 for new adapters, usage provenance/attempt dedupe and delivery ledger. Cache key version migration must not reinterpret existing SQLite entries.

Add packages/remote/test/proxy-streaming.test.ts; extend chat-usage.test.ts, chat-stream-usage.test.ts, rag-chat-endpoint.test.ts and core responsecache/proxy-integration.test.ts. Use a blocked-completion fixture proving first chunk arrives before completion, slow consumers, oversized captures, partial/error streams, abort and one billing record. Test non-stream-only AiProvider synthetic streaming.

Use bun:test with makeTempRuntime/envForTemp, makeCluster, random-port fixture servers and real fake executables; do not mock Bun.spawn. Report unavailable sibling checkouts as gaps. No production inference/credentials in hermetic CI.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Streaming misses remain incremental and memory bounded; incomplete/aborted/error responses never enter exact cache.
- [ ] One upstream execution yields one usage charge across tRPC/proxy paths; cache delivery is distinct.
- [ ] Tenant/account/protocol/revision mismatches cannot hit cache; peer/oMLX/KV regressions pass.

Enable scoped cloud exact caching only after completion and identity gates. Existing local exact cache remains usable. Keep legacy tRPC path until parity passes, then converge internally without a core→remote shim.

Parent: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/127
Phase: 2 — CLI
Depends on: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/133, https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/128.
Design: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/blob/docs/unified-ai-router-roadmap/docs/specs/2026-09-23-unified-ai-router-architecture.md

## Problem

The existing CLI provider is constructed in the calling process; agentName is metadata rather than dispatch, and advertised request.model does not by itself select the subprocess model. Proxying it directly would spawn on the wrong host or run the wrong model.

## Scope

1. Publish CLI deployments only from the declared execution owner after binary/preset/model validation. Preserve stable virtual node IDs and enforce mapping from public alias to configured model argv/env selector.
2. Add the minimal typed inference RPC now, with an embedded implementation, so routing reaches owner before createCliSubprocessProvider is called. Reuse direct TLS-pinned transport and existing tunnel subscriptions/cancel.
3. Adapt UnifiedStreamEvent to shared execution events and existing public codecs. Buffered Codex/Gemini/custom presets emit synthetic streaming from createResponse when real streaming is unavailable.
4. Expose only the supported text profile initially; reject images/tools/unsupported settings before spawn. Public clients cannot supply command, argv, cwd, login or environment.
5. Apply verified Penumbra reuse decisions from R0, with pinned citations and tests; don't copy an unreviewed adapter.

## Concrete file/module targets

## Contracts and schemas

## Test strategy

## Acceptance criteria

## Roadmap and dependencies

Parent: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/127
Phase: 2 — CLI
Depends on: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/134.
Design: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/blob/docs/unified-ai-router-roadmap/docs/specs/2026-09-23-unified-ai-router-architecture.md

## Problem

An HTTP-accessible subprocess backend needs explicit resource ownership throughout nonstream and streaming execution; unknown outcomes and error-then-done sequences must never trigger duplicate agent work.

## Scope

1. Add bounded per-worker and credential-account admission queues, timeout/deadline budgets, concurrency limits and rejection metadata. Ensure cancellation reaches both createResponse and streamResponse paths.
2. Bound stdout/stderr, line and event buffers, including output with no newline. Drain pipes safely and terminate process groups with bounded graceful/forced cleanup.
3. Make terminal outcome monotonic: successful completion, explicit failure, cancelled or unknown outcome. Error followed by done is not success; disconnect after acceptance is not a safe retry signal.
4. Enforce configured workspace roots, environment/credential isolation, executable allowlists and redaction. Record reported vs estimated usage without inventing subscription dollar cost.

## Concrete file/module targets

All paths below are repository-root relative. New paths are proposals, not claims about existing files.

- `packages/remote/src/execution/admission.ts` (new)
- `packages/remote/src/execution/cli-executor.ts`
- `packages/remote/src/cli/adapter.ts`
- `packages/remote/src/cli/presets.ts`
- `packages/core/src/config/schema.ts`
- `packages/remote/src/inference/usage.ts`

## Contracts and schemas

Bounded admission policy, execution lifecycle/outcome, usage quality and worker invocation revision. Define shared-account quota seam for fleet reservations later.

## Test strategy

Extend packages/remote/test/cli-adapter.test.ts and cli-stream.test.ts; add execution-admission.test.ts. Use real fake executable fixtures for hung processes, forked children, no-newline floods, partial output/nonzero exit, cancel before/after spawn, missing binary, queue overflow, secret redaction and errors followed by done.

Use bun:test with makeTempRuntime/envForTemp, makeCluster, random-port fixture servers and real fake executables; do not mock Bun.spawn. Run focused tests and required typecheck/lint plus the AGENTS.md four-repository gate (llamactl, nova, sirius-gateway, embersynth) for implementation slices. Report unavailable sibling checkouts as gaps. No production inference/credentials in hermetic CI.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every cancellation/timeout releases queue slots and process resources within the configured bound.
- [ ] No unbounded output accumulation; side-effecting ambiguous executions are never automatically replayed.
- [ ] CLI proxy fixtures pass for JSON/SSE on all supported codecs; owner accounting is single-writer.

## Migration, rollout and rollback

Keep caching and retries disabled; canary one explicit preset/account. Disable new admissions and drain boundedly on rollback; do not kill unrelated processes.

Phase: 2 — CLI
Depends on: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/134.
Design: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/blob/docs/unified-ai-router-roadmap/docs/specs/2026-09-23-unified-ai-router-architecture.md

## Problem

An HTTP-accessible subprocess backend needs explicit resource ownership throughout nonstream and streaming execution; unknown outcomes and error-then-done sequences must never trigger duplicate agent work.

## Scope

1. Add bounded per-worker and credential-account admission queues, timeout/deadline budgets, concurrency limits and rejection metadata. Ensure cancellation reaches both createResponse and streamResponse paths.
2. Bound stdout/stderr, line and event buffers, including output with no newline. Drain pipes safely and terminate process groups with bounded graceful/forced cleanup.
3. Make terminal outcome monotonic: successful completion, explicit failure, cancelled or unknown outcome. Error followed by done is not success; disconnect after acceptance is not a safe retry signal.
4. Enforce configured workspace roots, environment/credential isolation, executable allowlists and redaction. Record reported vs estimated usage without inventing subscription dollar cost.

## Concrete file/module targets

All paths below are repository-root relative. New paths are proposals, not claims about existing files.

- `packages/remote/src/execution/admission.ts` (new)
- `packages/remote/src/execution/cli-executor.ts`
- `packages/remote/src/cli/adapter.ts`
- `packages/remote/src/cli/presets.ts`
- `packages/core/src/config/schema.ts`
- `packages/remote/src/inference/usage.ts`

## Contracts and schemas

Bounded admission policy, execution lifecycle/outcome, usage quality and worker invocation revision. Define shared-account quota seam for fleet reservations later.

## Test strategy

Extend packages/remote/test/cli-adapter.test.ts and cli-stream.test.ts; add execution-admission.test.ts. Use real fake executable fixtures for hung processes, forked children, no-newline floods, partial output/nonzero exit, cancel before/after spawn, missing binary, queue overflow, secret redaction and errors followed by done.

Use bun:test with makeTempRuntime/envForTemp, makeCluster, random-port fixture servers and real fake executables; do not mock Bun.spawn. Run focused tests and required typecheck/lint plus the AGENTS.md four-repository gate (llamactl, nova, sirius-gateway, embersynth) for implementation slices. Report unavailable sibling checkouts as gaps. No production inference/credentials in hermetic CI.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every cancellation/timeout releases queue slots and process resources within the configured bound.
- [ ] No unbounded output accumulation; side-effecting ambiguous executions are never automatically replayed.
- [ ] CLI proxy fixtures pass for JSON/SSE on all supported codecs; owner accounting is single-writer.

## Migration, rollout and rollback

Keep caching and retries disabled; canary one explicit preset/account. Disable new admissions and drain boundedly on rollback; do not kill unrelated processes.

## Roadmap and dependencies

Parent: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/127
Phase: 3 — Semantic cache
Depends on: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/133.
Design: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/blob/docs/unified-ai-router-roadmap/docs/specs/2026-09-23-unified-ai-router-architecture.md

## Problem

Temperature zero or an exact request fingerprint does not justify approximate reuse. Semantic hits must be explicitly opted into, strictly scoped and evaluated before any response is served.

## Scope

1. Implement eligibility before embedding: initial single-turn text QA only. Bypass tools, structured output, seed/reproducibility profiles, CLI/ACP, sessions, multimodal, RAG and unsupported generation controls.
2. Define compatibility scope over authenticated tenant/account, public model and immutable generation/config revision, protocolVariant, system/policy fingerprint, generation parameters, embedding model/version/dimension and representation version.
3. Canonicalize only the eligible semantic text; hash all safety-relevant exact fields into the namespace. Do not truncate over-limit content or embed secrets silently. Keep Anthropic, Chat and Responses semantic caches isolated.
4. Build labeled paraphrases and hard negatives for numbers, negation, locale, system instructions and domain constraints. Record per-profile score threshold, TTL and maximum acceptable false-hit rate; a similarity score is not a correctness proof.

## Concrete file/module targets

All paths below are repository-root relative. New paths are proposals, not claims about existing files.

- `packages/core/src/semanticcache/eligibility.ts` (new)
- `packages/core/src/semanticcache/identity.ts` (new)
- `packages/core/src/semanticcache/types.ts` (new)
- `packages/core/src/config/schema.ts`
- `packages/core/src/cache-identity/canonical.ts` (preserve V1)
- `packages/core/test/semanticcache/fixtures/` (new)

## Contracts and schemas

CacheScopeV2 and SemanticCachePolicySchema with off|shadow|serve, allowlisted profile, cosine threshold, absolute TTL, embedder revision, limits and provenance. Distinct exact/semantic identities.

## Test strategy

Add packages/core/test/semanticcache/eligibility.test.ts and identity.test.ts. Test same text under different tenants, credential accounts, model/config/system/protocol scopes; all disallowed features; Unicode and length limits; old exact canonical keys remain unchanged.

Use bun:test with makeTempRuntime/envForTemp, makeCluster, random-port fixture servers and real fake executables; do not mock Bun.spawn. Run focused tests and required typecheck/lint plus the AGENTS.md four-repository gate (llamactl, nova, sirius-gateway, embersynth) for implementation slices. Report unavailable sibling checkouts as gaps. No production inference/credentials in hermetic CI.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Eligibility and strict namespace checks run before any embedding call.
- [ ] All protocol variants are isolated, and unsupported/side-effect profiles bypass approximate cache.
- [ ] Calibration dataset and decision fields are present; no default claim that a threshold is universally safe.

## Migration, rollout and rollback

LLAMACTL_SEMANTIC_CACHE defaults off. Ship policy and shadow instrumentation independently of serving. No migration or sensitive-prompt backfill.

Temperature zero or an exact request fingerprint does not justify approximate reuse. Semantic hits must be explicitly opted into, strictly scoped and evaluated before any response is served.

## Scope

1. Implement eligibility before embedding: initial single-turn text QA only. Bypass tools, structured output, seed/reproducibility profiles, CLI/ACP, sessions, multimodal, RAG and unsupported generation controls.

## Problem

Existing RAG embedding and pgvector plumbing can be reused, but RAG search lacks the response-cache scope/TTL and atomic complete-payload guarantees. A semantic result must not point to a lost SQLite payload on another node.

## Scope

1. Choose optional pgvector with HNSW for fleet-ready semantic storage; keep local exact-only SQLite deployments independent of Postgres. Reuse embedder bindings and SQL client, not the RAG adapter's document contract.
2. Create dedicated complete response/vector records with immutable scope/revisions, payload, completion proof, original expiry, embedding version/dimension, cost/size/provenance and indexes. Commit vector and payload atomically.
3. Implement cosine candidates with mandatory namespace/TTL filters and exact metadata/revision recheck. Validate pgvector version, dimension/index type limits, filtered ANN recall and candidate exhaustion; enable iterative scans or bounded exact fallback deliberately.
4. Wrap embedding with deadline/cancel, dimensional/finite/nonzero-norm validation, memoization and recursion/cache bypass. Fail open to upstream on cache/embedding failure within budget, without weakening tenant auth.

All paths below are repository-root relative. New paths are proposals, not claims about existing files.

Dedicated response payload/vector tables per design §5.4; pgvector extension/index/version checks, TTL and model-generation scope. No change to existing SQLite key interpretation.

Add packages/remote/test/semantic-cache-pgvector.test.ts and semantic-cache-migration.test.ts against real disposable PG/pgvector. ## Problem

The semantic tier must save work without adding embedding cost on exact hits, leaking scopes, extending old answers indefinitely or publishing partial streams.

## Scope

1. Wire exact lookup first, eligibility second, semantic lookup third and upstream last. Preserve worker-local KV only beneath upstream execution. Recheck scope/generation at lookup, publication and serve.
2. Publish only completed successful upstream answers. Promote semantic hits to exact only with provenance and original absolute expiry; never create semantic-from-semantic chains or slide TTL.
3. Extend responsecache/policy.ts scoring to include byte/vector quota, recency, frequency, actual avoided cost and age; hard-delete expired/revoked entries before scoring. Add bounded maintenance and per-tenant/model quotas.
4. Expose hit/miss/bypass, embedding/ANN latency and cost, avoided generation cost, false-hit evaluation, bytes/evictions and model revision. Shadow mode never changes answers or duplicates billable inference without a separately budgeted evaluation policy.
5. Require recorded per-profile safety/cost/latency approval before serve mode; rollback must be a single policy change.

Parent: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/127

Design: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/blob/docs/unified-ai-router-roadmap/docs/specs/2026-09-23-unified-ai-router-architecture.md

## Problem

The semantic tier must save work without adding embedding cost on exact hits, leaking scopes, extending old answers indefinitely or publishing partial streams.

## Scope

1. Wire exact lookup first, eligibility second, semantic lookup third and upstream last. Preserve worker-local KV only beneath upstream execution. Recheck scope/generation at lookup, publication and serve.
2. Publish only completed successful upstream answers. Promote semantic hits to exact only with provenance and original absolute expiry; never create semantic-from-semantic chains or slide TTL.
3. Extend responsecache/policy.ts scoring to include byte/vector quota, recency, frequency, actual avoided cost and age; hard-delete expired/revoked entries before scoring. Add bounded maintenance and per-tenant/model quotas.
4. Expose hit/miss/bypass, embedding/ANN latency and cost, avoided generation cost, false-hit evaluation, bytes/evictions and model revision. Shadow mode never changes answers or duplicates billable inference without a separately budgeted evaluation policy.

issues.title: [AI router P4.1] Version proxy–worker RPC, auth and bounded direct/tunnel streaming
issues.body:
## Roadmap and dependencies

Parent: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/127
Phase: 4 — Separation
Depends on: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/135, https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/138.
Design: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/blob/docs/unified-ai-router-roadmap/docs/specs/2026-09-23-unified-ai-router-architecture.md

## Problem

Independent proxy replicas require a stable worker execution contract. Existing tunnels provide stream/cancel primitives, but public peer forwarding is not equivalent to explicit owner RPC and some transport queues remain unbounded.

## Scope

1. Expand the Phase 2 seam into negotiated versioned catalog, execute, cancel and status contracts with accepted/unknown-outcome semantics, deadlines, route/model generations, tenant claims, attempt IDs and feature requirements.
2. Implement equivalent embedded and remote clients; select direct TLS-pinned or reverse-tunnel transport by the declared owner. Execute a fixed deployment directly rather than recursively re-entering public model routing.
3. Bind service credentials to allowed worker operations/models/tenants; public client identity is authenticated and translated into verified internal scope, never a trusted raw header.
4. Bound frames, event queues and slow-consumer buffers; propagate cancellation, process acceptance, terminal errors and stream completion across tunnel reconnects. No automatic retry after output or uncertain acceptance.
5. Specify one refresh on stale catalog, hop/loop protection and unsupported required-schema rejection.

## Concrete file/module targets

All paths below are repository-root relative. New paths are proposals, not claims about existing files.

- `packages/core/src/inference/rpc-schema.ts` (new)
- `packages/remote/src/inference/procedures.ts`
- `packages/remote/src/inference/client.ts`
- `packages/remote/src/tunnel/messages.ts`
- `packages/remote/src/tunnel/router-bridge.ts`
- `packages/remote/src/tunnel/tunnel-server.ts`
- `packages/remote/src/server/auth.ts`

## Contracts and schemas

InferenceRpcV1, ExecutionEventV1, service authorization claims, capability negotiation, execution status/cancel, routeVersion and generation fence. Required unknown features fail closed.

## Test strategy

Add packages/remote/test/inference-rpc.test.ts and proxy-worker-contract.test.ts; extend tunnel suites. Verify embedded/direct/tunnel golden equivalence, disconnect at each acceptance point, slow consumers, bounded queues, token rotation, stale generation, revoked model ACL and unsupported version.

Use bun:test with makeTempRuntime/envForTemp, makeCluster, random-port fixture servers and real fake executables; do not mock Bun.spawn. Run focused tests and required typecheck/lint plus the AGENTS.md four-repository gate (llamactl, nova, sirius-gateway, embersynth) for implementation slices. Report unavailable sibling checkouts as gaps. No production inference/credentials in hermetic CI.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Identical RPC semantics across embedded/direct/tunnel clients; no re-entry routing loop.
- [ ] Cancellation and backpressure propagate to the true owner; unknown outcomes are not replayed.
- [ ] Proxy needs service identity only, not worker provider secrets or subprocess credentials.

## Migration, rollout and rollback

Deploy worker protocol support before remote proxies. LLAMACTL_PROXY_EXECUTION=embedded|remote retains embedded default; support an explicit rolling-upgrade compatibility window.

## Verified baseline references

Baseline: frozename/llamactl@7443403912ab3976d18bc288de3009e2c23b7afb. The implementation acceptance tests listed above are planned, not claimed as implemented or passing. Reference inspection is complete in R0.

issues.body:
## Roadmap and dependencies

Parent: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/127
Phase: 4 — Separation
Depends on: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/139.
Design: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/blob/docs/unified-ai-router-roadmap/docs/specs/2026-09-23-unified-ai-router-architecture.md

## Problem

Moving a file alone does not separate scaling. HTTP/stream orchestration must leave core while workload lifecycle, process spawning, credentials and llama.cpp/oMLX KV ownership stay on workers.

## Scope

1. Create packages/proxy as a thin Bun composition root using remote transport/adapters and core pure contracts. Add configuration, readiness, bounded drain, catalog subscription and service identity.
2. Move orchestration from core/openaiProxy.ts into remote/proxy/handler.ts and supporting modules; preserve pure translators/policy in core. Move local-model transport and KV session orchestration to worker execution modules.
3. Atomically migrate all actual imports, server mounts, tRPC entrypoints, package exports and root build scripts; remove core/openaiProxy.ts after callers move. Do not create a permanent core→remote compatibility shim.
4. Run proxy-only processes with no runtime-directory or spawn requirement; retain embedded mode through the same handler/executor interfaces. Workers continue lifecycle/control operations independently.
5. Move transport tests to remote while preserving assertions and existing local/peer/oMLX behavior.

## Concrete file/module targets

All paths below are repository-root relative. New paths are proposals, not claims about existing files.

- `packages/proxy/package.json` (new)
- `packages/proxy/tsconfig.json` (new)
- `packages/proxy/src/main.ts` (new)
- `packages/proxy/src/config.ts` (new)
- `packages/remote/src/proxy/handler.ts` (new)
- `packages/remote/src/proxy/catalog-client.ts` (new)
- `packages/remote/src/execution/local-model-executor.ts` (new)
- `packages/remote/src/execution/kv-session.ts` (new)
- `packages/core/src/openaiProxy.ts` (remove after migration)
- `packages/core/src/index.ts`
- `packages/remote/src/index.ts`
- `packages/remote/src/server/serve.ts`
- `packages/remote/src/router.ts`
- `package.json`

## Contracts and schemas

Proxy service config and readiness/drain state; no new workload lifecycle schema. In-flight state and disposable catalog snapshots are the only proxy-owned request state.

## Test strategy

Add packages/proxy/test/standalone.test.ts and packages/remote/test/proxy-drain.test.ts. Start proxy with no model directory/no spawn privileges, two workers and fake backends; exercise three protocols, restart/drain, cancellation and worker KV slot lease lifetime. Retain/move existing integration tests rather than deleting coverage.

Use bun:test with makeTempRuntime/envForTemp, makeCluster, random-port fixture servers and real fake executables; do not mock Bun.spawn. Run focused tests and required typecheck/lint plus the AGENTS.md four-repository gate (llamactl, nova, sirius-gateway, embersynth) for implementation slices. Report unavailable sibling checkouts as gaps. No production inference/credentials in hermetic CI.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Proxy replicas scale/restart independently; no local model directory, login or executable is needed.
- [ ] Workers own all KV slots, processes and sessions through completion/abort.
- [ ] Dependency checks enforce core pure logic; embedded and standalone outputs/errors remain equivalent.

## Migration, rollout and rollback

Remote execution opt-in; preserve public /v1 endpoints and CLI/app workflows. Workers first, then proxies; rollback selects embedded composition without core importing remote.

## Verified baseline references

Baseline: frozename/llamactl@7443403912ab3976d18bc288de3009e2c23b7afb. The implementation acceptance tests listed above are planned, not claimed as implemented or passing. Reference inspection is complete in R0.

issues.title: [AI router P4.3] Expose cache-service RPC and durable fleet exact-cache records
issues.body:
## Roadmap and dependencies

Parent: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/127
Phase: 4 — Separation
Depends on: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/139.
Design: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/blob/docs/unified-ai-router-roadmap/docs/specs/2026-09-23-unified-ai-router-architecture.md

## Problem

A stateless proxy tier cannot rely on another proxy's SQLite file for correctness or availability. Fleet cache storage needs a service boundary and durable payload ownership while embedded exact-only mode remains supported.

## Scope

1. Expose scoped exact/semantic lookup, complete put, invalidation and status via authenticated cache-service RPC with deadlines and model-generation checks.
2. Add durable PG exact payload records for managed fleet mode; retain embedded SQLite and optionally use local SQLite as a disposable accelerator. Never use a cross-node file path as the payload authority.

## Problem

Local-wins/first-fresh-peer drops replicas, and snapshot-based scheduler election is an observation mechanism rather than authoritative consensus. Shard/session ownership needs versioned transactional terms.

## Scope

2. Reuse peer snapshot polling and fleet-supervisor observations, while adding PG-backed compare-and-swap membership, leases, fencing terms and shard-map publication for managed mode. Use database time for lease decisions.
3. Separate model equivalence/revision from process restart incarnation and cache generation. Never infer provider equivalence from matching model labels.
4. Define stale/duplicate/out-of-order update handling, bounded last-known-good routing and coordinator partition behavior. Session claims/revocations fail closed without valid authority.
5. Feed ownership observations into supervisor placement/migration without replacing its workload safety gates or claiming its existing lease election is consensus.

## Concrete file/module targets

## Test strategy

Add packages/remote/test/coordination-partition.test.ts; extend peer-snapshot-poller and fleet suites. Test competing owners, stale leases, database-time expiry, reordered snapshots, split views, model swap during generation, revoked owners and crash recovery.

Run focused tests and required typecheck/lint plus the AGENTS.md four-repository gate (llamactl, nova, sirius-gateway, embersynth) for implementation slices.
