issues.body:
## Roadmap and dependencies

Parent: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/127
Phase: 5 — Fleet
Depends on: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/142, https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/140, https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/141.
Design: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/blob/docs/unified-ai-router-roadmap/docs/specs/2026-09-23-unified-ai-router-architecture.md

## Problem

Model-only hashing creates hotspots, while hashing prompt bytes destroys semantic affinity. Execution placement and exact/semantic cache ownership must be distinct decisions over the same authorized route identity.

## Scope

1. Implement deterministic weighted rendezvous over authorized, capable, healthy, non-draining equivalent execution deployments. Key stateless work by scoped request affinity; bind sessions to owner. Add bounded-load admission/fallback without evading shared account quotas.
2. Route exact cache by scoped canonical request key to stable virtual shards. Route semantic lookup by compatibility namespace to the same index for paraphrases; do not hash prompt bytes for semantic ownership.
3. Use published map version/fences; allow bounded pre-acceptance stateless failover and one stale-map refresh. Never retry CLI/ACP or any request with unknown acceptance/output; prevent forwarding loops.
4. Add shared credential-account reservation/accounting across proxy replicas and route explanation/status via remote tRPC and CLI dispatcher.
5. Observe mode compares selected destinations without duplicate execution. Keep centroid/multiprobe semantic partitioning deferred until a measured hot namespace justifies recall complexity.

## Concrete file/module targets

All paths below are repository-root relative. New paths are proposals, not claims about existing files.

- `packages/core/src/routing/rendezvous.ts` (new)

issues.body:
## Roadmap and dependencies

Parent: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/127
Phase: 5 — Fleet
Depends on: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/143.
Design: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/blob/docs/unified-ai-router-roadmap/docs/specs/2026-09-23-unified-ai-router-architecture.md

## Problem

Changing a cache owner is not equivalent to replicating its data. The fleet needs explicit logical ownership transfer over durable storage pools and controlled behavior during partial copies, model swaps and failures.

## Scope

1. Implement transfer states plan→copy→catch-up→drain→fenced cutover→retire with a durable cursor/outbox, idempotent writes, versioned ownership and bounded dual-read window.
2. Distinguish stateless cache-service replica failover over the same PG pool from copying a shard between pools. Use PG HA replication for storage durability; do not claim snapshots/tunnels replicate databases.
3. Preserve strict scope, original TTL, invalidation generation and payload/vector atomicity throughout transfer. Expired/revoked entries never become live at a new owner.
4. Document drain/capacity/replication-lag gates, partial-transfer resume/abort, old-owner fencing, last-known-good map bounds and rollback that freezes movement.
5. Expose shard status, transfer progress and rejected stale writes without high-cardinality metrics or secret data.

## Concrete file/module targets

All paths below are repository-root relative. New paths are proposals, not claims about existing files.

- `packages/remote/src/cache/rebalance.ts` (new)
- `packages/remote/src/coordination/shard-map.ts`
- `packages/remote/src/coordination/leases.ts`
- `packages/remote/src/cache/maintenance.ts`
- `packages/remote/src/cache/client.ts`
- `packages/remote/src/cache/pgvector-store.ts`
- `packages/core/src/routing/shards.ts`

## Contracts and schemas

Transfer state/cursor/outbox, storagePoolId, owner term, dual-read expiry and schema generation. Replication/copy operations preserve origin provenance and absolute expiry.

## Test strategy

Add packages/remote/test/cache-rebalance.test.ts; extend coordination-partition.test.ts and proxy-fleet-routing.test.ts. At least two proxies/three workers/cache instances with fault injection: join/leave, interrupted copy, duplicate batches, cutover crash, lagging replica, old owner writes, model swap, expiry mid-transfer and coordinator loss.

Use bun:test with makeTempRuntime/envForTemp, makeCluster, random-port fixture servers and real fake executables; do not mock Bun.spawn. Run focused tests and required typecheck/lint plus the AGENTS.md four-repository gate (llamactl, nova, sirius-gateway, embersynth) for implementation slices. Report unavailable sibling checkouts as gaps. No production inference/credentials in hermetic CI.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every failure point either resumes transfer or serves/bypasses safely without exposing stale/cross-scope payloads.
- [ ] Fenced old owners cannot write after cutover; byte-distinct semantic requests retain index affinity.
- [ ] Operational runbook defines PG HA responsibilities, lag gates and rollback; no unverified exactly-once claim.

## Migration, rollout and rollback

Enable movement only after observe and stable rendezvous gates. Rollback freezes transfers and uses a valid stable map; never remove revision fencing to regain availability.

[AI router P5.3] Rebalance cache shards and validate join/leave, replication and partitions

## Roadmap and dependencies

Parent: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/127
Phase: 5 — Fleet
Depends on: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/143.
Design: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/blob/docs/unified-ai-router-roadmap/docs/specs/2026-09-23-unified-ai-router-architecture.md

## Problem

Changing a cache owner is not equivalent to replicating its data. The fleet needs explicit logical ownership transfer over durable storage pools and controlled behavior during partial copies, model swaps and failures.

## Scope

1. Implement transfer states plan→copy→catch-up→drain→fenced cutover→retire with a durable cursor/outbox, idempotent writes, versioned ownership and bounded dual-read window.
2. Distinguish stateless cache-service replica failover over the same PG pool from copying a shard between pools. Use PG HA replication for storage durability; do not claim snapshots/tunnels replicate databases.
3. Preserve strict scope, original TTL, invalidation generation and payload/vector atomicity throughout transfer. Expired/revoked entries never become live at a new owner.
4. Document drain/capacity/replication-lag gates, partial-transfer resume/abort, old-owner fencing, last-known-good map bounds and rollback that freezes movement.
5. Expose shard status, transfer progress and rejected stale writes without high-cardinality metrics or secret data.

## Concrete file/module targets

All paths below are repository-root relative. New paths are proposals, not claims about existing files.

- `packages/remote/src/cache/rebalance.ts` (new)
- `packages/remote/src/coordination/shard-map.ts`
- `packages/remote/src/coordination/leases.ts`
- `packages/remote/src/cache/maintenance.ts`
- `packages/remote/src/cache/client.ts`
- `packages/remote/src/cache/pgvector-store.ts`
- `packages/core/src/routing/shards.ts`

## Contracts and schemas

Transfer state/cursor/outbox, storagePoolId, owner term, dual-read expiry and schema generation. Replication/copy operations preserve origin provenance and absolute expiry.

## Test strategy

Add packages/remote/test/cache-rebalance.test.ts; extend coordination-partition.test.ts and proxy-fleet-routing.test.ts. At least two proxies/three workers/cache instances with fault injection: join/leave, interrupted copy, duplicate batches, cutover crash, lagging replica, old owner writes, model swap, expiry mid-transfer and coordinator loss.

Use bun:test with makeTempRuntime/envForTemp, makeCluster, random-port fixture servers and real fake executables; do not mock Bun.spawn. Run focused tests and required typecheck/lint plus the AGENTS.md four-repository gate (llamactl, nova, sirius-gateway, embersynth) for implementation slices. Report unavailable sibling checkouts as gaps. No production inference/credentials in hermetic CI.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every failure point either resumes transfer or serves/bypasses safely without exposing stale/cross-scope payloads.
- [ ] Fenced old owners cannot write after cutover; byte-distinct semantic requests retain index affinity.
- [ ] Operational runbook defines PG HA responsibilities, lag gates and rollback; no unverified exactly-once claim.

## Migration, rollout and rollback

Enable movement only after observe and stable rendezvous gates. Rollback freezes transfers and uses a valid stable map; never remove revision fencing to regain availability.

issues.body:
## Roadmap and dependencies

Parent: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/127
Phase: 6 — ACP
Depends on: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/128, https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/135, https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/140.
Design: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/blob/docs/unified-ai-router-roadmap/docs/specs/2026-09-23-unified-ai-router-architecture.md

## Problem

ACP has no first-class llamactl implementation at the reviewed baseline. Introduce an ACP client adapter on execution workers using the official protocol and verified Penumbra patterns, without treating agent-owned tools as caller-owned OpenAI tool calls.

## Scope

1. Pin official ACP SDK/schema and selected real agent versions; incorporate R0's Penumbra reuse matrix. Implement stdio JSON-RPC initialize/capability negotiation, explicit authentication, session/new, prompt, session/update and cancel; do not assume draft HTTP transport is production-stable.
2. Expose an ephemeral text-only compatibility profile through the shared executor and all three public codecs. Define accepted history/system semantics explicitly; reject unsupported role/tool/multimodal features before spawning rather than silently flattening them.
3. Map agent text updates incrementally, terminal stop reasons and cancellation/errors to common events. Keep agent tool lifecycle as metadata; do not emit caller tool_calls for work already executed by the agent. Unknown usage stays unknown.
4. Add bounded connection/process/session pools, frame sizes, queues, timeouts and idle retirement. Reject late updates after termination; cancellation resolves pending permissions as cancelled and cleans up subprocess resources.
5. Deny interactive permission requests in ordinary inference mode. Worker execution profiles own login, environment and sandboxed workspace; declining filesystem capabilities alone is not OS isolation.

## Concrete file/module targets

All paths below are repository-root relative. New paths are proposals, not claims about existing files.

- `packages/core/src/inference/acp-policy.ts` (new)
- `packages/core/src/config/schema.ts`
- `packages/remote/src/acp/adapter.ts` (new)
- `packages/remote/src/acp/connection.ts` (new)
- `packages/remote/src/acp/pool.ts` (new)
- `packages/remote/src/acp/translate-events.ts` (new)
- `packages/remote/src/acp/permissions.ts` (new)
- `packages/remote/src/acp/workspace.ts` (new)
- `packages/remote/src/config/provider-nodes.ts`
- `packages/remote/src/providers/factory.ts`
- `packages/remote/src/inference/procedures.ts`
- `packages/remote/src/execution/admission.ts`

## Contracts and schemas

AcpBindingSchema, pinned capability/profile and protocol versions, owner, workspace/permission policy, terminal outcome. Keep SDK implementation types remote; pure policy contracts core.

## Test strategy

Add packages/remote/test/acp-adapter.test.ts, acp-permissions.test.ts and proxy-acp.test.ts. Real fake ACP executable speaks JSON-RPC; cover init/auth/version failure, malformed/oversized frames, fragmented Unicode, interleaved sessions, unsupported features before spawn, tool denial, cancel/late updates, process death, no duplicate tools and three-protocol JSON/SSE. Add opt-in smoke tests for pinned real agents.

Use bun:test with makeTempRuntime/envForTemp, makeCluster, random-port fixture servers and real fake executables; do not mock Bun.spawn. Run focused tests and required typecheck/lint plus the AGENTS.md four-repository gate (llamactl, nova, sirius-gateway, embersynth) for implementation slices. Report unavailable sibling checkouts as gaps. No production inference/credentials in hermetic CI.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Ephemeral ACP text is reachable by model from Chat, Responses and Messages clients with bounded streaming/cancel.
- [ ] No permission auto-allow, public executable/cwd override or agent-to-client double tool execution.
- [ ] Selected real agents pass the advertised capability profile; no cache or automatic retry.

## Migration, rollout and rollback

LLAMACTL_PROXY_ACP=off|ephemeral|sessions defaults off. Enable per vetted binding/profile after reference and sandbox review; ephemeral can ship before fleet stateful sessions.

## Verified baseline references

Baseline: frozename/llamactl@7443403912ab3976d18bc288de3009e2c23b7afb. The implementation acceptance tests listed above are planned, not claimed as implemented or passing. Reference inspection is complete in R0.

- **S01 — Repository boundaries and conventions:** [AGENTS.md: 17–136](https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/blob/7443403912ab3976d18bc288de3009e2c23b7afb/AGENTS.md#L17-L136); [AGENTS.md: 633–654](https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/blob/7443403912ab3976d18bc288de3009e2c23b7afb/AGENTS.md#L633-L654).

Re-pin supported spec/SDK/agent versions at implementation.


## Execution and review discipline

Shared schema/proxy edits have one owner at a time. Use the focused bun:test paths above, then `bun run typecheck`, `bun run lint`, and `bun test` in llamactl, Nova, sirius-gateway and embersynth. If Nova changes, run `bun install` in each consumer first. Expected: exit 0, zero failures/errors; record actual baseline and added assertion counts. A shell/environment failure is not a product pass. Flags and rollback below must be tested before activation; no time estimates.

## Reference-review decisions and additional acceptance gates

Completed R0 adaptation decisions are mandatory: [packages/agentchat/src/adapters/stdio-acp.ts:1474–1522](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/src/adapters/stdio-acp.ts#L1474-L1522); [packages/agentchat/src/adapters/stdio-acp.ts:1786–1839](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/src/adapters/stdio-acp.ts#L1786-L1839); [packages/agentchat/src/adapters/acp-warm-pool.ts:100–175](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/src/adapters/acp-warm-pool.ts#L100-L175); [packages/agentchat/test/adapters/stdio-acp-integration-warm-reuse.test.ts:75–159](https://github.com/frozename/penumbra/blob/c264644bc2b4f1e1429e845208fd6ca7f6426d62/packages/agentchat/test/adapters/stdio-acp-integration-warm-reuse.test.ts#L75-L159). The inspected stdio path buffers until done, sends an agent-specific session/new.model, and pools by agent/repo plus a limited spec hash; none are sufficient for the public adapter.

Add `packages/remote/test/fixtures/acp-agent.ts` (new protocol fixture), `packages/remote/test/acp-model-selection.test.ts` and `packages/remote/test/acp-pool-isolation.test.ts`. Fixture blocks final prompt response until the test consumes an actual first public delta. Verify returned protocolVersion, advertised configOptions and acknowledged selection via session/set_config_option when supported; legacy selectors require pinned conformance. Refuse an advertised but unenforceable requested model. Start with process pooling disabled; test tenant/account/credential-generation/workspace/binary-policy separation before opt-in reuse.

issues.body:
## Roadmap and dependencies

Parent: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/127
Phase: 6 — ACP
Depends on: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/145, https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/issues/143.
Design: https://github.com/frozename/llamactl/blob/docs/unified-ai-router-roadmap/docs/specs/2026-09-23-unified-ai-router-architecture.md

## Problem

Stateful agent sessions carry side effects, workspaces and credentials that cannot migrate like stateless requests. Resumption must be capability-gated, tenant-bound and protected against concurrent turns and stale owners.

## Scope

1. Implement opaque tenant-scoped session handles bound to worker/connection/session incarnation, owner lease/fence, expected turn and agent/config revision. Reject concurrent or replayed turns unless explicitly idempotent.
2. Support optional load/resume/close only when negotiated with the pinned agent. Suppress replayed updates from loaded history; do not claim generic transcript replay can recover side effects or migrate opaque sessions.
3. Add approved automation permission policies through the authenticated control plane, with audit records and path/symlink-safe workspace checks under an actual process sandbox. Public inference requests cannot grant themselves approval.
4. Define idle TTL, max sessions, retirement, owner loss, drain and unknown-outcome responses. On owner failure require explicit recovery or a new session; never silently reroute to a CLI fallback.
5. Add registration/doctor/status through core schema, remote tRPC and CLI dispatcher; surface capabilities/login readiness without secrets.

## Concrete file/module targets

All paths below are repository-root relative. New paths are proposals, not claims about existing files.

- `packages/remote/src/acp/sessions.ts` (new)
- `packages/remote/src/coordination/migrations/002-session-ownership.sql` (new)
- `packages/remote/src/acp/permissions.ts`
